about: Product photography. Two kinds: (1) photos sourced via Kimi (Sep 2026) from supplier, marketplace and editorial sites — the owners' permission was received in Oct 2026 ("permission": "GRANTED"), so they're imported live and shown first; (2) manufacturer pack shots for the cement catalogue (Manus, Oct 2026; AfriSam, Cemza and NPC permission confirmed Oct 2026, so live); (3) open-licence photos from Wikimedia Commons (an "openLicence" block), live with the credit their licence requires. A sourced photo without "permission": "GRANTED" is imported hidden (PERMISSION_PENDING) until staff record permission in Admin -> Image permissions. "retiredOpenLicence" lists Commons photos taken down in Oct 2026 (weak matches). See PRODUCT_IMAGES.md.
